ctx.x: No, I met his brother, but he knew of me, Willie the Lion was a big man in New York. I hadn't made New York yet. I was over there. So while I was sleeping it seems as though that the man who owned the place had enraged the chef and the chef creased his head with a cleaver, so wasn't nobody in -- the doors were locked, but I could get out the back, you know, and I was in there by myself, and the chef had left was what necessary to be eaten and I stayed there about three months, and then I said, well, my goodness,…

let me play for the motion pictures, because had I played for the motion pictures, they would have got me.
